objectName: ZephyrCoanda Bladeless Tower Fan & HEPA H13 Air Purifier
tagline: Aerodynamic Coanda air-multiplier loop with 360° True HEPA H13 filtration, mixed-flow centrifugal blower, acoustic Helmholtz diffuser & PWM speed telemetry
description: Commercial bladeless purifying fans like the Dyson Purifier Cool TP07 ($549–$649) charge over $500 for an injection-molded ABS Coanda loop, a $14 brushless centrifugal blower, and a cylindrical HEPA cartridge. Our DIY version splits the aerodynamic Coanda airfoil loop and 360° intake base into 9 support-free PETG/PLA+ printed vessels paired with $49.20 of off-the-shelf blower, True HEPA H13 filter, PM2.5 sensor, and 24V PWM electronics.
functionSummary: Draws dusty room air through a 360° perforated lower shroud and cylindrical True HEPA H13 + activated carbon cartridge using a high-static-pressure 24V centrifugal blower, straightens swirl through an acoustic stator diffuser cone, and ejects a high-velocity 1.5mm annular sheet across a 16° Coanda airfoil ramp to entrain 15x ambient airflow.

originalProduct.name: Dyson Purifier Cool TP07 Air Multiplier & HEPA H13 Tower
originalProduct.whyExpensive: Patented brand premium, multi-cavity injection molding tooling, and proprietary RFID-chipped replacement filter lock-in.

keyMechanisms: Annular 1.5mm Coanda jet slot + 16° NACA-inspired inner airfoil ramp multiplying primary blower mass flow by 12–15× via viscous shear entrainment
360° radial intake shroud with twist-lock compression seal around a standard off-the-shelf cylindrical True HEPA H13 + carbon filter
Swirl-recovery stator diffuser cone that converts tangential blower velocity into static plenum pressure while cutting blade-pass noise by 9 dB
Closed-loop 25kHz PWM blower control with laser PM2.5 particulate sensor and front rotary encoder bezel
engineeringNotes: Print PRT-07 and PRT-08 (Coanda Airfoil Lower & Upper Loop Halves) with 0.16mm layer height, 3 perimeters, and scarf seams for a smooth internal air plenum.
Seat an EPDM closed-cell foam gasket strip along the PRT-03 HEPA compression ring so zero unfiltered air bypasses the cartridge.
Fits across 2 build plates on a Bambu Lab A1 / P1S / X1C (256×256×256 mm).
materialsNeeded: PETG Filament (~310g) for base pan, HEPA intake shell, impeller volute & pressurized neck collar
Matte PLA+ Filament (~210g) for upper/lower Coanda airfoil loop halves, diffuser cone & control bezel
120×32mm 24V Centrifugal Blower + True HEPA H13 Cylinder Filter + 25kHz PWM Controller + PM2.5 Sensor + 24V 3A PSU
